### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][25]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][26]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][27].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][28]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][29]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][30]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][31].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][32]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][33]

Jul 21, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel launches next-generation thermal gap filler with 6.5W/m∙K conductivity

Rising thermal loads in vehicle electronics are increasing the need for high-performance thermal
management solutions, especially in advanced applications such as ADAS, ECUs, or power conversion
components in electric vehicles. To address this fast-evolving challenge, Henkel Adhesive
Technologies has launched Bergquist Gap Filler TGF 6500LVO, a next-generation thermal gap filler
with 6.5W/m∙K thermal conductivity. This new material enables more effective heat transfer in
critical systems, helping manufacturers manage increasing power density and maintain performance and
reliability.

Jul 9, 2026 - Press Release
150 Years of Henkel’s History Presented in New Book

Henkel was founded in 1876 and celebrates its 150th anniversary this year – a special milestone that
draws attention to the company’s long and multifaceted history. In the run-up to this anniversary,
Prof. Dr. Joachim Scholtyseck, Professor of Modern and Contemporary History at the University of
Bonn, has conducted a comprehensive academic study of Henkel’s development over several years. In
his independent research, he traces the company’s evolution from a local laundry detergent
manufacturer to a publicly listed global company.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

# Advanced Structural Adhesives

Engineered Bonding Solutions, LLC comprises well over 50 years of combined experience in the
composites and structural adhesives market.

Our exclusive formulations have a wide variety of “open working” and “fixture” times to
substantially increase the throughput of assemblies of similar and dissimilar materials.

## [ ACRALOCK SIGN ADHESIVES ][87]

Create permanent, high-strength bonds on steel, aluminum, and engineered plastics with ACRALOCK sign
adhesives. Our flexible, low-exotherm formulas are designed for pristine aesthetics—eliminating
surface distortion and print-through on ACM panels, while our clear adhesives prevent shadowing in
channel letters. Backed by UL certification on select products, we deliver reliability you can
trust.

## [ ACRAMAXX ][88]

ACRAMAXX series adhesives are the most advanced toughened structural adhesives products in the
industry. With product features like non halogen, primerless metal bonding (including HDG and EZG
galvanized metal), capable of resisting high oven bake temperatures and still providing long term
harsh environmental performance. The ACRAMAXX product line continues to expand the technology and
create new possibilities for manufacturers to eliminate welding, rivets and other mechanical joining
methods, while improving production speed, product design, and durability of the assemblies.

## [ ACRALOCK ][89]

ACRALOCK by Engineered Bonding Solutions, LLC, are advanced two component methacrylate structural
adhesives, with many products that are transparent clear or others with varying strength and
flexibility, thin to thick gap filling, bond to a wide variety surfaces, and most are primerless to
bare metals, providing a permanently locked or integrated assembly of steel, aluminum, engineered
plastics, high performance composites and other materials.

## [ POLYTACK ][90]

If you’re looking for the best multi-resin compatible, closed molding process, spray tack adhesive
for dry reinforcements, please see our sister company, Polytack, manufacturers of MT-1, the most
compatible chemistry for use in a wide range of resins (UPR – Unsaturated Polyester Resins, Vinyl
Ester Resins, and Epoxy Resins). MT-1 is specifically formulated to tack dry reinforcements in all
types of closed molded processes; Resin Transfer Molding – RMT, Vacuum Assisted Resin Transfer
Molding – VARTM, Light Resin Transfer Molding – LRTM, Closed Cavity Bag Molding – CCBM,
Infusion-resin infused under bag with vacuum, Epoxy Pre-Preg or Epoxy resin pre-wetted reinforcing
fabrics.

### Industries We Adhere To

For over 15 years, ACRALOCK and ACRAMAXX products have been providing innovative *engineered bonding
solutions* for the most demanding processes and applications in the harshest environments. ACRALOCK
and ACRAMAXX products are advanced two-component methacrylate structural adhesives designed to bond
chemically to most surfaces, and primerless to most bare metals. This provides permanently locked or
integrated assemblies of steel, aluminum, engineered plastics, high performance composites, and most
any other bonding surface.

### Sign Adhesive Manufacturer

Our sign adhesives offer numerous benefits including; high strength permanent bonds to steel,
aluminum and most engineered plastics. Our flexible products have high peel strength and have a low
exotherm with little to no bond line print-through or surface distortion on most plastics or
Aluminum Composite Materials (ACM) panels. Our Clear adhesives for channel lettering are ideal to
eliminate bond line shadowing. In addition, several of our ACRALOCK sign adhesives carry UL
certification.
[ Sign Adhesives Info & Products ][91]

### Marine Adhesives

With over 15 years of proven marine bonding performance, and a complete adhesive line for every
marine structural bonding application developed for all types of vessels, small craft to large
yachts.
[ Marine Adhesive Info & Products ][92]

### Transportation Adhesives

Whether you’re manufacturing trains, buses, heavy trucks, trailers, coaches, or recreational
vehicles, ACRALOCK and ACRAMAXX adhesives have been setting new standards for bonding performance
worldwide.

# Advanced Structural Adhesives

Engineered Bonding Solutions, LLC comprises well over 50 years of combined experience in the
composites and structural adhesives market.

Our exclusive formulations have a wide variety of “open working” and “fixture” times to
substantially increase the throughput of assemblies of similar and dissimilar materials.

## [ ACRALOCK SIGN ADHESIVES ][87]

Create permanent, high-strength bonds on steel, aluminum, and engineered plastics with ACRALOCK sign
adhesives. Our flexible, low-exotherm formulas are designed for pristine aesthetics—eliminating
surface distortion and print-through on ACM panels, while our clear adhesives prevent shadowing in
channel letters. Backed by UL certification on select products, we deliver reliability you can
trust.

## [ ACRAMAXX ][88]

ACRAMAXX series adhesives are the most advanced toughened structural adhesives products in the
industry. With product features like non halogen, primerless metal bonding (including HDG and EZG
galvanized metal), capable of resisting high oven bake temperatures and still providing long term
harsh environmental performance. The ACRAMAXX product line continues to expand the technology and
create new possibilities for manufacturers to eliminate welding, rivets and other mechanical joining
methods, while improving production speed, product design, and durability of the assemblies.

## [ ACRALOCK ][89]

ACRALOCK by Engineered Bonding Solutions, LLC, are advanced two component methacrylate structural
adhesives, with many products that are transparent clear or others with varying strength and
flexibility, thin to thick gap filling, bond to a wide variety surfaces, and most are primerless to
bare metals, providing a permanently locked or integrated assembly of steel, aluminum, engineered
plastics, high performance composites and other materials.

## [ POLYTACK ][90]

If you’re looking for the best multi-resin compatible, closed molding process, spray tack adhesive
for dry reinforcements, please see our sister company, Polytack, manufacturers of MT-1, the most
compatible chemistry for use in a wide range of resins (UPR – Unsaturated Polyester Resins, Vinyl
Ester Resins, and Epoxy Resins). MT-1 is specifically formulated to tack dry reinforcements in all
types of closed molded processes; Resin Transfer Molding – RMT, Vacuum Assisted Resin Transfer
Molding – VARTM, Light Resin Transfer Molding – LRTM, Closed Cavity Bag Molding – CCBM,
Infusion-resin infused under bag with vacuum, Epoxy Pre-Preg or Epoxy resin pre-wetted reinforcing
fabrics.

### Industries We Adhere To

For over 15 years, ACRALOCK and ACRAMAXX products have been providing innovative *engineered bonding
solutions* for the most demanding processes and applications in the harshest environments. ACRALOCK
and ACRAMAXX products are advanced two-component methacrylate structural adhesives designed to bond
chemically to most surfaces, and primerless to most bare metals. This provides permanently locked or
integrated assemblies of steel, aluminum, engineered plastics, high performance composites, and most
any other bonding surface.

### Sign Adhesive Manufacturer

Our sign adhesives offer numerous benefits including; high strength permanent bonds to steel,
aluminum and most engineered plastics. Our flexible products have high peel strength and have a low
exotherm with little to no bond line print-through or surface distortion on most plastics or
Aluminum Composite Materials (ACM) panels. Our Clear adhesives for channel lettering are ideal to
eliminate bond line shadowing. In addition, several of our ACRALOCK sign adhesives carry UL
certification.
[ Sign Adhesives Info & Products ][91]

### Marine Adhesives

With over 15 years of proven marine bonding performance, and a complete adhesive line for every
marine structural bonding application developed for all types of vessels, small craft to large
yachts.
[ Marine Adhesive Info & Products ][92]

### Transportation Adhesives

Whether you’re manufacturing trains, buses, heavy trucks, trailers, coaches, or recreational
vehicles, ACRALOCK and ACRAMAXX adhesives have been setting new standards for bonding performance
worldwide.
[ Transportation Adhesive Info & Products ][93]

### Renewable Energy Adhesives

Wind Power Blade Adhesive, Blade Repairing Adhesives, Nacelle bonding Adhesive, EV and Solar
[ Renewable Energy Adhesive Info & Products ][94]

### Construction Adhesives

Composite Bridges, Composite Docks, Composite Tanks and Piping and Architectural Applications
